xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the Additional Commissioner of Income Tax, (Transfer Pricing) (CIT-TP), Chennai
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company had received on 29.01.2026 an Order dated 28.01.2026 from Transfer Pricing Officer (TPO) u/s 92 CA (3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 for the AY 2023-24 proposing adjustment for fuel cost and sale price of power in respect of transactions between sugar and cogeneration segments of the company. Together TPO had proposed a reduction in eligible profits by Rs.34.05 Crores as against the company’s original computation of Rs.24.70 Crores. TPO has further advised the assessing officer to invoke penalty u/s 271AA for non-reporting of transaction with an associate company, if deemed fit.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
In Continuation of order of TPO, the Company received on 22.02.2026, the draft assessment order dated 22.02.2026 passed by the Assessment Unit , Income Tax Department.
In response, the Company filed its objections to the aforesaid draft asessment order with Dispute Resolution Panel on 23.03.2026.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the Commissioner of Income Tax, (Transfer Pricing) (CIT-TP), Chennai
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The company had received on 27.03.2026 an Order dated 27.03.2026 from Commissioner of Income Tax (Transfer Pricing) (CIT-TP), Chennai u/s 263 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 directing the TPO to revise the earlier order dated 26.10.2023 for AY 2021-22. In this order, CIT-TP has set aside only the issue of determination of the Arm's Length Price (ALP) of inter unit transfer of bagasse from sugar unit to the eligible co-gen unit and directed the TPO to pass the order in this regard after applying correct law and giving due opportunity of being heard to the assesse.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
The methodology followed for transfer pricing in the view of the company is not legally tenable that however has a material financial bearing.
Writ Petition before Hon'ble High Court of Madras praying to quash the order dt.27.03.2026 passed by CIT-TP and to grant interim stay of operation of the aforesaid order is being filed by the Company.
